judge.rationale: The candidate only produced a Definition of Done (`.lore/dod.md`) and a failing acceptance test (`src/transport/listConversations.acceptance.test.ts`), stopping after the red phase without implementing any production code. None of the required changes to `src/types/messages.ts`, `validation.ts`, `createMessageHandler`, `createServer.ts`, `config.ts`, `sessionStore.ts`, specs, or documentation are present. Furthermore, the candidate's own run record confirms that all 3 tests it added fail because `list_conversations` is still an unknown message type. In addition, the candidate's first two test assertions overlook that connecting creates a fresh session for `u1` in `InMemorySessionStore`, so the returned list will include that fourth empty session as well.
